truthfulness.note: This repository describes a concept and open interfaces. It does not authorize physical operation, manufacturing, production deployment, or control of machinery.

thesis: Begin as a human-operated mobile manipulator, learn from consented physical demonstrations, collaborate with Agents through a constrained gateway, and only later explore bounded task and tool autonomy.

value_hypotheses.name: physical_labor_and_cost
value_hypotheses.claim: Bounded teleoperation may reduce high-load physical exposure and total cost per qualified task.
value_hypotheses.priority_test_context: High-wage markets, including the United States, without assuming positive ROI.

value_hypotheses.name: labor_shortage_resilience
value_hypotheses.claim: Modular robotic labor may improve production resilience where demographic change or hiring constraints leave tasks unmet.

value_hypotheses.name: physical_data_for_world_models
value_hypotheses.claim: Consented, provenance-preserving multimodal trajectories may improve prediction and action selection in unseen physical settings.

goals: Enable low-barrier human teleoperation of a wheeled manipulator through a game controller or equivalent device.
Record consented, synchronized physical episodes with separate human intent, Agent proposal, safety modification, and executed command streams.
Allow Agents to interpret tasks, recommend registered tools, and propose bounded skills without direct actuator access.
Create an auditable lifecycle for proposing, verifying, fabricating, inspecting, registering, and authorizing new tools.
Keep interfaces modular, reproducible, vendor-neutral, and readable by humans and Agents.
non_goals: Claiming that a workerless factory, general autonomy, or production-grade safety currently exists.
Granting an Agent open-world physical authority or runtime self-promotion.
Treating model confidence, natural-language intent, simulation, or a demonstration video as safety evidence by itself.
Bypassing native safety interlocks of robots, printers, machine tools, vehicles, or facilities.
Weapons, injury, coercion, or non-consensual personnel surveillance.

capability_levels.name: human_teleoperation
capability_levels.physical_scope: human commands under independent safety control

capability_levels.name: agent_shadow_advisor
capability_levels.physical_scope: Agent proposals never enter execution automatically

capability_levels.name: supervised_bounded_autonomy
capability_levels.physical_scope: pre-approved skills constrained by task, tool, zone, speed, force, payload, and time

capability_levels.name: bounded_cell_autonomy
capability_levels.physical_scope: isolated cell with validated skills, tools, and local safety control

versioning.history: append-only; new versions supersede rather than overwrite
